profile.name: PCAN CAN总线接口适配器
profile.description: PCAN 是一种用于将计算机连接到 CAN 或 CAN FD 总线网络的硬件接口设备。它常用于实验室和工程环境中，与嵌入式控制器、车辆电子节点、工业设备或自研仪器进行报文收发、总线监听、调试、参数配置和通信测试。
profile.description_en: A PCAN device is a hardware interface that connects a computer to a CAN or CAN FD bus network. It is commonly used in laboratories and engineering environments to exchange messages with embedded controllers, vehicle electronics, industrial equipment, or custom instruments for bus monitoring, debugging, parameter configuration, and communication testing.
